name: AIIMS Pulse (New Delhi)
organizer: AIIMS Students' Union, All India Institute of Medical Sciences, New Delhi
eligibility: MBBS, BDS, and allied health students from recognized medical colleges across South Asia
prize_or_certificate: AIIMS Pulse Trophy, Cash awards exceeding INR 10,00,000, AIIMS Certificate of Participation
notes: Flagship South Asian medical festival; premier networking hub for residency aspirants; includes Basic Surgical Skills, BLS & Disaster Triage workshops, and the AIIMS Mediquiz.

name: AFMC Silhouettes (Pune)
organizer: Armed Forces Medical College, Pune
eligibility: Undergraduate medical students (MBBS) across India
prize_or_certificate: AFMC Prestigious Shields, Cash pool INR 4,00,000+, Merit Certificates
notes: Renowned military medical college festival; features Tactical Combat Casualty Care workshop, Military Medicine Simulation, and Forensic Mock Crime Scene Investigation.

name: CMC Pegasus (Vellore)
organizer: Christian Medical College Vellore Students' Association
eligibility: Medical and allied health science undergraduates nationwide
prize_or_certificate: CMC Pegasus Rolling Trophy, Cash prizes, Institutional Merit Certificates
notes: Celebrated for academic and bioethical rigor; features Brain Drain Medical Quiz, Clinical Case Presentations, and Suturing & Knot-Tying workshops.

name: KMC Verve & Utsav (Manipal)
organizer: Kasturba Medical College & Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE)
eligibility: Inter-medical and university students across India
prize_or_certificate: MAHE Certificate of Honor, Cash awards
notes: Utilizes one of Asia's largest medical simulation centres (C-MET) for high-fidelity student workshops and Med-Tech hackathons.

name: JIPMER Spandan (Puducherry)
organizer: JIPMER Students' Association (JSA), Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education & Research
eligibility: MBBS and medical undergraduates across India
prize_or_certificate: Spandan Rolling Cup, Cash awards up to INR 5,00,000, JIPMER JSA Certificates
notes: One of the largest medical fests in Southern India; features South Zone Medical Olympiad, Surgical Wet-Lab, and Forensic Autopsy workshops.

name: MAMC Synapse (New Delhi)
organizer: Maulana Azad Medical College, New Delhi
eligibility: Medical and dental undergraduates nationwide
prize_or_certificate: MAMC Synapse Excellence Trophy, Certificates of Merit
notes: Premier medical fest in Delhi NCR; hosts national-level clinical case presentations, Synapse Mediquiz, and ECG & Radiology masterclasses.

name: St. John's Autumn Muse (Bengaluru)
organizer: St. John's Medical College, Bengaluru
eligibility: Medical and health sciences students across India
prize_or_certificate: Autumn Muse Trophies, Cash awards, Institutional Certificates
notes: Oldest medical college festival in South India (35+ years); features Emergency Resuscitation Workshop and Medical Ethics & Bioethics Debate.

name: Grant Medical Aesthetics / Astitva (Mumbai)
organizer: Grant Government Medical College & Sir J.J. Group of Hospitals, Mumbai
eligibility: Medical students in Maharashtra and across Western India
prize_or_certificate: GGMC Gymkhana Certificate, Cash awards
notes: Historic institute established in 1845; offers Cadaveric Surgical Exposure Workshop, Clinical Case Presentations, and State Mediquiz.

name: KGMU Rhapsody / Riyazat (Lucknow)
organizer: King George's Medical University, Lucknow
eligibility: Medical students across Northern and Central India
prize_or_certificate: KGMU Commendation Certificates, Cash rewards
notes: Major academic and networking convergence in Uttar Pradesh; includes Orthopedic Plaster & Splinting Workshop and Inter-College Mediquiz.

name: KMC Mangalore Helicon (Mangalore)
organizer: Kasturba Medical College, Mangalore
eligibility: Medical undergraduates nationwide
prize_or_certificate: Helicon Shield, Merit Certificates
notes: Coastal medical conference and fest; features Coastal Medicine & Toxicology Symposium, Radiology Imaging Quiz, and Basic Surgical Suturing.

name: BJGMC Asclepius & Vedant (Pune)
organizer: B.J. Government Medical College & Sassoon General Hospital, Pune
eligibility: Medical undergraduates and postgraduates across India
prize_or_certificate: Maharashtra Medical Council (MMC) Credit Points, Certificates of Merit
notes: Asclepius is one of India's pioneering undergraduate medical research conferences; includes CPR simulation and research presentation awards.

name: IMS BHU Elixir (Varanasi)
organizer: Institute of Medical Sciences, Banaras Hindu University, Varanasi
eligibility: Medical students nationwide
prize_or_certificate: IMS BHU Trophy, Merit Certificates
notes: Integrates modern clinical medicine with ancient medical sciences; features Clinical Diagnostics Workshop and Mediquiz.

name: LHMC Splash (New Delhi)
organizer: Lady Hardinge Medical College & Associated Hospitals, New Delhi
eligibility: Medical students from across India
prize_or_certificate: LHMC Rolling Trophy, Institutional Certificates
notes: Focuses on maternal and child healthcare; features Maternal & Neonatal Resuscitation Workshop and High-Risk Obstetrics Simulation.

name: MMC Revivals (Chennai)
organizer: Madras Medical College, Chennai
eligibility: Medical students across Tamil Nadu and South India
prize_or_certificate: MMC Medallions, Official Merit Certificates
notes: Founded in 1835; celebrated for Cardiology ECG Masterclass, Dermatology Spotters, Anatomy Quiz, and pathology museums.

name: IAP National Undergraduate Pediatric Quiz
organizer: Indian Academy of Pediatrics (IAP)
eligibility: Final year MBBS Undergraduates and Interns (teams of 2 from same institution)
frequency: Annual (Multi-tier: College -> Divisional -> State -> Zonal -> National Finals)
typical_month: July (College) to January (National Finals at PEDICON)
prize_or_certificate: National Champions Trophy, Cash prizes up to INR 25,000, Formal citation at PEDICON, IAP Certificate
notes: Most prestigious undergraduate medical quiz in India; tests complex clinical vignettes, dysmorphology, and neonatal management.

name: NNF National Neonatal Quiz for Undergraduates and Postgraduates
organizer: National Neonatology Forum (NNF) India
eligibility: MBBS Students (UG track) and MD/DNB Pediatrics residents (PG track)
prize_or_certificate: NNF Gold Medal, Cash prizes up to INR 30,000, NNF Fellowship travel grants
notes: Rigorous focus on neonatal physiology, mechanical ventilation, premature infant care, and surfactant therapy.

name: Torrent Young Scholar Award (TYSA) - General Surgery & Specialties
organizer: Torrent Pharmaceuticals in collaboration with ASI (Association of Surgeons of India)
eligibility: Final year Postgraduates (MD/MS/DNB) in General Surgery, General Medicine, Pediatrics, Cardiology, and Gynecology
prize_or_certificate: National Winner receives international educational travel grant up to INR 2,00,000+, prestigious TYSA Trophy, citation
notes: Pinnacle postgraduate talent hunt in India; judged by national stalwarts of surgical and medical specialties.

name: Cardiological Society of India (CSI) Young Investigator Award
organizer: Cardiological Society of India (CSI)
eligibility: DM/DNB Cardiology trainees or young cardiologists aged under 40 years
frequency: Annual (Awarded at CSI Annual National Conference)
prize_or_certificate: Gold Plaque, Cash prize INR 50,000, travel sponsorship, publication in Indian Heart Journal (IHJ)
notes: Premier national platform for presenting original clinical cardiology research in India.

name: RSSDI National Diabetes Quiz
organizer: Research Society for the Study of Diabetes in India (RSSDI)
eligibility: MBBS Undergraduates, Interns, and MD/DNB General Medicine residents
frequency: Annual (State rounds -> National finals at RSSDI Conference)
prize_or_certificate: RSSDI Young Scholar Award, Cash awards up to INR 50,000, textbook grants, National Certificate
notes: Tests in-depth understanding of diabetes etiology, clinical trials (UKPDS, ACCORD), therapeutics, and complications.

name: FOGSI National Inter-Collegiate Quiz (Dr. Usha Krishna Quiz)
organizer: Federation of Obstetric and Gynaecological Societies of India (FOGSI)
eligibility: Postgraduates (MD/MS/DGO/DNB OBGYN) and Undergraduates (UG track)
prize_or_certificate: FOGSI National Trophy, AICOG Travel Fellowship, Certificates
notes: Covers high-risk obstetrics, reproductive endocrinology, gynecological oncology, and maternal mortality reduction.

name: IMA National Mediquiz
organizer: Indian Medical Association (IMA) Headquarters & MSN
eligibility: MBBS students from medical colleges with active IMA Medical Students' Network chapters
prize_or_certificate: IMA President's Rolling Trophy, Cash prizes up to INR 25,000, National IMA Certificate
notes: Cross-disciplinary quiz spanning all 19 NMC subjects from Anatomy and Forensic Medicine to Surgery and Pediatrics.

name: SOCA National Anatomy Olympiad & Quiz
organizer: Society of Clinical Anatomists (SOCA)
eligibility: 1st year MBBS students across India
prize_or_certificate: Dr. Inderbir Singh Memorial Gold Medal, National Certificate of Honor
notes: Rigorous test of gross anatomy, embryology, neuroanatomy, and clinical cross-sectional radiology.

name: APPI National Medical Physiology Quiz
organizer: Association of Physiologists and Pharmacologists of India (APPI)
eligibility: 1st and 2nd year MBBS students
prize_or_certificate: APPI Young Scholar Trophy, Cash award, Certificate of Merit
notes: Focuses on organ system physiology, molecular mechanisms, and pharmacological correlates.

name: IADVL IGNOC National Dermatology Quiz
organizer: Indian Association of Dermatologists, Venereologists and Leprologists (IADVL)
eligibility: Dermatology PG residents (MD/DNB/DVD)
prize_or_certificate: DERMACON International travel scholarship, IADVL Gold Medal, National citation
notes: Prestigious visual spotters, histopathology, and clinical therapeutics quiz for dermatology residents.

name: AIIMS Pulse Med-Q (National Medical Quiz)
organizer: AIIMS New Delhi Students' Union
eligibility: MBBS Undergraduates from all Indian medical colleges (teams of 2)
prize_or_certificate: INR 50,000 Cash Prize pool, AIIMS Certificate of Distinction
notes: Demanding clinical diagnostic puzzles, audio-visual rounds, and rapid-fire clinical reasoning.

name: CMC Vellore Brain Drain Quiz
organizer: Christian Medical College, Vellore
eligibility: Undergraduate medical students across India
prize_or_certificate: Pegasus Rolling Trophy, INR 20,000 Cash Prize, Institutional Certificate
notes: Deep-rooted quizzing tradition testing lateral medical trivia, history of medicine, and clinical puzzle rounds.

name: Basic Life Support (BLS) Provider
organizer: American Heart Association (AHA) / Indian Resuscitation Council Federation (IRCF)
eligibility: MBBS students (from 1st year onwards), interns, residents, nurses, and registered medical practitioners
prize_or_certificate: Official AHA/IRCF BLS Provider eCard (valid 2 years)
notes: Mandatory baseline resuscitation credential for internship, NABH hospital accreditation, and prerequisite for ACLS/PALS.

name: Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support (ACLS) Provider
organizer: American Heart Association (AHA) / IRCF
eligibility: Final year MBBS students, interns, medical officers, and PG residents with valid BLS prerequisite
prize_or_certificate: Official AHA ACLS Provider eCard (valid 2 years)
notes: Essential requirement for ICU, emergency department, and anesthesia postings; prerequisite for US/UK observerships.

name: Pediatric Advanced Life Support (PALS) Provider
organizer: American Heart Association (AHA) / Indian Academy of Pediatrics (IAP)
eligibility: Interns, PG residents in Pediatrics/Anesthesia/Emergency Medicine, and general practitioners
prize_or_certificate: Official AHA PALS Provider eCard (valid 2 years)
notes: Core credential for pediatric ICU and neonatal postings; substantial asset for international pediatric training.

name: Advanced Trauma Life Support (ATLS) Student Course
organizer: American College of Surgeons (ACS) Committee on Trauma / ATLS India
eligibility: Registered Medical Practitioners (MBBS graduates, Interns with provisional registration, Surgery/Orthopedic/Emergency residents)
frequency: Quarterly courses across accredited Indian medical colleges
prize_or_certificate: ACS ATLS Provider Certificate & International Card (valid 4 years)
notes: Gold standard global trauma credential; highly valued in emergency surgery, polytrauma centers, and NHS/US trauma units.

name: Neonatal Resuscitation Program (NRP) Provider
organizer: Indian Academy of Pediatrics (IAP) & National Neonatology Forum (NNF)
eligibility: MBBS students, interns, Pediatric/OBGYN residents, NICU nurses and staff
prize_or_certificate: IAP-NNF Certified NRP Provider Certificate (valid 2 years)
notes: Mandatory under NABH guidelines for all healthcare providers attending deliveries in Indian hospitals.

name: Advanced Life Support in Obstetrics (ALSO)
organizer: American Academy of Family Physicians (AAFP) / ALSO India
eligibility: Interns, OBGYN residents, and medical officers handling labor rooms and maternal emergencies
prize_or_certificate: AAFP ALSO Provider Certificate (valid 3 years)
notes: Critical credential for managing postpartum hemorrhage, shoulder dystocia, and maternal sepsis; valuable for NHS UK OBGYN posts.

name: Fundamental Critical Care Support (FCCS)
organizer: Society of Critical Care Medicine (SCCM) / ISCCM
eligibility: Post-MBBS medical officers, residents in Internal Medicine, Surgery, Anesthesia, and Pulmonology
frequency: Bi-monthly courses across accredited tertiary ICUs
prize_or_certificate: SCCM FCCS Certificate of Successful Completion (valid 4 years)
notes: Gateway qualification for ICU medical officers and clinical associates in tertiary corporate hospitals in India.

name: MRCP (UK) Part 1
organizer: Federation of Royal Colleges of Physicians of the UK
eligibility: MBBS degree from an institution listed in WDOMS / recognized by GMC UK; completed 12 months internship
prize_or_certificate: MRCP (UK) Part 1 Pass Certificate (valid 7 years towards complete diploma)
notes: Primary gateway to UK NHS Internal Medicine Training (IMT); immense prestige and marketability in Indian corporate healthcare.

name: MRCS (Intercollegiate) Part A
organizer: Royal Surgical Colleges of England, Edinburgh, Glasgow, and Ireland
eligibility: Primary medical qualification (MBBS) recognized by GMC UK
prize_or_certificate: Intercollegiate MRCS Part A Pass Certificate (valid 7 years towards Part B)
notes: Benchmark qualification for UK Core Surgical Training (CST); prestigious milestone for Indian surgical postgraduates.

name: USMLE Step 1
organizer: Federation of State Medical Boards (FSMB) & NBME / ECFMG Intealth
eligibility: MBBS students and graduates from Indian medical colleges listed in WDOMS with an active ECFMG sponsor note. In September 2023, the National Medical Commission (NMC) was granted 10-year WFME recognition status (2023-2033), guaranteeing that all NMC-approved Indian colleges meet ECFMG 2024 accreditation standards.
frequency: Year-round computer-based test at Prometric centers in India
prize_or_certificate: USMLE Step 1 Official Score Transcript (Pass/Fail)
notes: Foundational milestone for US residency match (NRMP). Indian MBBS students can appear after 2nd prof. ECFMG 2024 compliance fully resolved by NMC WFME accreditation.

name: USMLE Step 2 CK (Clinical Knowledge)
organizer: FSMB & NBME / ECFMG Intealth
eligibility: Enrolled in or graduated from NMC/WDOMS approved Indian medical college with active ECFMG sponsor note; WFME-accredited through NMC
frequency: Year-round computer-based test at Prometric centers in India
prize_or_certificate: USMLE Step 2 CK Numerical Score Report (passing standard 214)
notes: Single most critical numerical score predicting US residency interview invitations and Match success for Indian medical graduates (IMGs).

name: USMLE Step 3
organizer: Federation of State Medical Boards (FSMB)
eligibility: Must hold ECFMG Certification (passed Step 1, Step 2 CK, and verified English/clinical communication via OET Medicine under ECFMG Pathways) + primary Indian MBBS degree
frequency: Year-round computer-based test in Prometric centers in the United States
prize_or_certificate: USMLE Step 3 Pass Certificate / Federation Licensing Examination Transcript
notes: Final licensing exam for unsupervised clinical practice in the US; essential for Indian doctors to secure H-1B visa sponsorship over J-1.

name: PLAB 1 (Professional and Linguistic Assessments Board)
organizer: General Medical Council (GMC), United Kingdom
eligibility: Recognized primary medical qualification (MBBS) + valid IELTS Academic (>=7.5 overall, >=7.0 in all bands) or OET Medicine (Grade B minimum in all sub-tests)
frequency: 4 test dates per year at British Council centres in India (Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai, Kolkata, Bengaluru)
prize_or_certificate: GMC PLAB 1 Result Confirmation (valid 3 years to pass PLAB 2)
notes: First clinical exam hurdle for Indian doctors seeking GMC registration and NHS clinical fellow positions in the UK.

name: PLAB 2 (Clinical Examination / OSCE)
organizer: General Medical Council (GMC), United Kingdom
eligibility: Passed PLAB 1 within preceding 3 years + valid English language test
frequency: Year-round at GMC Assessment Centres in Manchester, UK
prize_or_certificate: PLAB 2 Pass Letter; grants eligibility for Full GMC Registration with License to Practice
notes: 16-station Objective Structured Clinical Examination in Manchester; qualifies Indian MBBS graduates for full UK medical license.

name: Australian Medical Council (AMC) MCQ Examination (CAT)
organizer: Australian Medical Council (AMC)
eligibility: Primary medical degree (MBBS) from an institution listed in WDOMS; primary source verification via EPIC (ECFMG)
frequency: Monthly testing windows at Pearson VUE centers in India
prize_or_certificate: AMC MCQ Examination Results Certificate (indefinite validity)
notes: Qualifies Indian doctors for the AMC Standard Pathway; enables provisional registration in Australian public hospital networks.

name: DHA General Practitioner Licensing Exam
organizer: Dubai Health Authority (DHA), United Arab Emirates
eligibility: MBBS degree + 1-year internship + minimum 2 years continuous clinical experience post-internship; verified via DataFlow PSV
frequency: Continuous computer-based testing at Prometric centers in India
prize_or_certificate: DHA Eligibility Letter (valid 1 year to activate license upon employment)
notes: Gateway to tax-free clinical practice in Dubai; easily converted to Abu Dhabi (DoH) or UAE federal (MOH) licenses.

name: HAAD / DoH Abu Dhabi Licensing Exam
organizer: Department of Health (DoH), Abu Dhabi
eligibility: MBBS degree + 1-year internship + 2 years clinical experience; Primary Source Verification through DataFlow
frequency: Continuous Prometric computer-based testing in India
prize_or_certificate: DoH Abu Dhabi Exam Pass Letter (valid 5 years)
notes: Enables clinical recruitment across SEHA government hospitals and private healthcare networks in Abu Dhabi and Al Ain.

name: National Exit Test (NExT) Step 1 & Step 2
organizer: National Medical Commission (NMC) / NBEMS
eligibility: Final year MBBS students in Indian medical colleges and Foreign Medical Graduates (FMGs)
prize_or_certificate: Statutory License to Practice in India + Merit Rank for MD/MS/DNB Postgraduate Admissions
notes: Comprehensive statutory licensing and PG entrance exam designed to replace university final examinations and NEET-PG in India.

name: DNB PDCET (Post Diploma Centralized Entrance Test)
organizer: National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS)
eligibility: Candidates who have passed a recognized 2-year Post-Graduate Diploma (DA, DGO, DCH, DOrtho, etc.)
prize_or_certificate: NBEMS Merit Scorecard for 2-Year Secondary DNB Postgraduate Seats
notes: Allows post-diploma doctors to enter 2-year secondary DNB training, upgrading their qualification to full MD/MS equivalence.

name: Fellow of Indian Association of Gastrointestinal Endo-Surgeons (FIAGES)
organizer: Indian Association of Gastrointestinal Endo-Surgeons (IAGES)
eligibility: MS/DNB in General Surgery or Gynecology with minimum 2 years experience in laparoscopic surgery
frequency: Multiple 3-day fellowship courses annually across India
prize_or_certificate: Lifetime FIAGES Fellowship Certificate & Convocation Scroll
notes: Premier national fellowship verifying laparoscopic surgical competency in minimal access surgery across Indian hospitals.

name: Certificate Course in Evidence Based Diabetes Management (CCEBDM)
organizer: Public Health Foundation of India (PHFI) & Dr. Mohan's Diabetes Education Academy
eligibility: MBBS graduates, MD/DNB in Internal Medicine, Family Medicine, or Community Medicine
prize_or_certificate: PHFI & SAFES Certified Diabetes Specialist Certificate
notes: Gold-standard academic certification for establishing outpatient diabetic clinics and managing chronic metabolic disorders.

name: Fellowship in Intensive Care Medicine (FICM)
organizer: Indian Society of Critical Care Medicine (ISCCM) / Apollo Medvarsity
eligibility: MBBS with internship completed + 1 year ICU experience, or MD/DNB in Anesthesia/Medicine/Chest Medicine
prize_or_certificate: ISCCM Fellowship Certificate in Intensive Care Medicine
notes: Catalyst for appointment as Senior Resident or ICU Registrar in quaternary corporate hospitals in India.

name: ICMR Short Term Studentship (STS)
organizer: Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), MoHFW
eligibility: MBBS and BDS undergraduate students from recognized Indian colleges before appearing in final year examinations
prize_or_certificate: ICMR Certificate of Honor + Stipend of INR 10,000/month (INR 20,000 total historical; up to INR 60,000 revised total based on milestone approvals)
notes: Premier undergraduate medical research program in India. Protocols submitted online at sts.icmr.org.in. Requires Institutional Ethics Committee (IEC) clearance and faculty guide mentorship. Stipend: INR 10,000/month.

name: ICMR Junior Research Fellowship (ICMR-JRF)
organizer: Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR)
eligibility: Post-MBBS doctors or Master's degree holders (M.Sc.) in Life Sciences / Biomedical Sciences with >=55% marks; Age limit 28 years
prize_or_certificate: ICMR Research Fellowship (INR 37,000/month JRF, INR 42,000/month SRF + HRA + INR 20,000/year contingency)
notes: Central research fellowship fully funding doctoral (Ph.D.) and clinician-scientist training in biomedical sciences.

name: DBT BioCARE (Biotechnology Career Advancement and Re-orientation Programme)
organizer: Department of Biotechnology (DBT), Ministry of Science & Technology
eligibility: Unemployed or employed women scientists and medical researchers with MD/MS/Ph.D. in biomedical sciences; upper age limit 45 years
prize_or_certificate: Research grant up to INR 40,00,000 - 50,00,000 + monthly fellowship of INR 67,000 + HRA
notes: Flagship national initiative empowering women clinician-investigators to build independent laboratory tracks.

name: DST INSPIRE Fellowship
organizer: Department of Science and Technology (DST), Ministry of Science & Technology
eligibility: 1st rank holders in University examinations (MBBS, MD, or M.Sc.) or INSPIRE Scholars with >=70% aggregate marks
prize_or_certificate: DST INSPIRE Fellowship (INR 37,000 - 42,000/month + HRA + INR 20,000/year contingency)
notes: Elite fellowship for high-academic achievers pursuing translational medical and doctoral research.

name: SERB / ANRF National Post Doctoral Fellowship (N-PDF)
organizer: Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF) / SERB
eligibility: Indian citizens with MD/MS/MDS or Ph.D. in clinical/biomedical disciplines; age limit 35 years
prize_or_certificate: Fellowship of INR 80,000/month (consolidated) + INR 2,00,000/year contingency grant + overheads
notes: Premier post-doctoral fellowship in India hosted at apex institutions (AIIMS, IISc, IITs, PGIMER).

name: CSIR-UGC NET Junior Research Fellowship (Biomedical & Life Sciences)
organizer: Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR) & UGC
eligibility: MBBS graduates, BS-MS, M.Sc. or equivalent degree with minimum 55% marks
frequency: Twice a year (June and December cycles)
prize_or_certificate: CSIR JRF Award (INR 37,000/month + HRA + INR 20,000 annual contingency)
notes: National benchmark credential for entry into faculty and scientist positions across CSIR biomedical laboratories.

name: Lady Tata Memorial Trust (LTMT) Junior Research Scholarship
organizer: Lady Tata Memorial Trust, Bombay House, Mumbai
eligibility: Indian nationals holding MBBS/MD or M.Sc. with >=60% aggregate, enrolled for doctoral research in leukemic and oncological disorders
prize_or_certificate: LTMT Research Scholarship (INR 31,000 - 35,000/month + INR 30,000/year contingency + HRA)
notes: Historic philanthropic scholarship offering unparalleled prestige in hematology and oncology.

name: ICMR Financial Support for MD/MS/DM/MCh Thesis
organizer: Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR)
eligibility: Postgraduate medical students enrolled in NMC-recognized medical colleges undertaking thesis research for MD/MS/DM/MCh
frequency: Twice a year (June 30 and December 31 deadlines)
prize_or_certificate: INR 50,000 lump sum financial grant for thesis diagnostic kits, reagents, and clinical consumables
notes: Direct ICMR funding stamp on postgraduate dissertations, dramatically improving indexation and publication odds.

name: RGUHS Undergraduate Research Grants
organizer: Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences (RGUHS), Karnataka
eligibility: Regular MBBS/BDS undergraduates studying in medical colleges affiliated with RGUHS Karnataka
prize_or_certificate: INR 15,000 - 20,000 project grant per student + University Research Commendation
notes: State-level university research award providing foundational research experience prior to ICMR-STS.

name: MUHS Short Term Research Grant for Health Sciences Students (STRG)
organizer: Maharashtra University of Health Sciences (MUHS), Nashik
eligibility: Undergraduate & Postgraduate students enrolled in MUHS-affiliated medical colleges in Maharashtra
prize_or_certificate: INR 10,000 - 25,000 research grant per approved protocol + official MUHS Research Certificate
notes: Formal state university research credit, eligible for presentation at state research conferences.

name: Tata Memorial Centre (TMC), Mumbai - Clinical Observership in Oncology
organizer: Tata Memorial Hospital & ACTREC, Mumbai (Department of Atomic Energy)
eligibility: Post-internship MBBS doctors, Postgraduates (MD/MS/DNB), Super-specialty fellows (NMC registered)
prize_or_certificate: Official TMC Observership Completion Certificate
notes: India's apex comprehensive cancer centre; departments include Surgical Oncology, Medical Oncology, and Head & Neck Surgery; standard rotation 4 weeks.

name: NIMHANS Bengaluru - Clinical Observership & Short-Term Training
organizer: National Institute of Mental Health and Neurosciences (Institute of National Importance)
eligibility: PG Medical Students (MD/DNB), MBBS Interns/Doctors, Clinical Psychologists
frequency: Bimonthly intakes (1st and 16th of each month)
prize_or_certificate: NIMHANS Official Certificate of Clinical Training
notes: Asia's leading neuropsychiatric institute; departments include Psychiatry, Neurology, Neurosurgery, and Neuroimaging; 1 to 3 months duration.

name: SGPGIMS Lucknow - Short Term Training & Observership
organizer: Sanjay Gandhi Postgraduate Institute of Medical Sciences, Lucknow
eligibility: Post-MBBS doctors, MD/MS/DNB residents, DM/MCh trainees from recognized institutes
prize_or_certificate: SGPGIMS Training Wing Certificate
notes: Apex quaternary center for solid organ transplants, Gastroenterology, Nephrology, Endocrine Surgery, and Critical Care; 1 to 3 months duration.

name: AIIMS New Delhi - Elective Clinical Training & Observership
organizer: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, New Delhi (Academic Section)
eligibility: Undergraduate medical students (completed 3rd year MBBS), Interns, and PG residents from NMC-recognized institutions
prize_or_certificate: AIIMS Academic Section Certificate of Elective Training
notes: Premier apex medical institution of India; departments include Cardiology, CTVS, Pediatrics, Orthopedics, Dr. R.P. Centre (Ophthalmology), and Emergency Medicine.

name: Sankara Nethralaya (Chennai) - Clinical Observership in Ophthalmology
organizer: Sankara Nethralaya (Medical Research Foundation), Chennai
eligibility: MS/DNB/DO Ophthalmology residents and certified practicing ophthalmologists
prize_or_certificate: Sankara Nethralaya Academy Certificate of Observership
notes: Renowned globally for high-volume retinal microsurgery, corneal transplants, and pediatric ophthalmology; 2 to 4 weeks duration.

name: SCTIMST Thiruvananthapuram - Neurosciences & Cardiovascular Observership
organizer: Sree Chitra Tirunal Institute for Medical Sciences and Technology (Institute of National Importance under DST)
eligibility: Postgraduates (MD/MS/DNB) or Super-specialty fellows (DM/MCh)
prize_or_certificate: SCTIMST Institute Certificate of Clinical Observership
notes: Pioneer in biomedical technology and advanced neurovascular surgery, comprehensive stroke units, and interventional neuroradiology; 2 weeks to 2 months.

name: NITRD New Delhi - Pulmonology & Thoracic Surgery Observership
organizer: National Institute of Tuberculosis and Respiratory Diseases (Autonomous Institute under MoHFW)
eligibility: MBBS Interns, MD/DNB Respiratory Medicine and General Medicine residents
prize_or_certificate: NITRD Official Government Certificate of Clinical Training
notes: Apex reference center in South Asia for multi-drug resistant (MDR) and extensively drug-resistant (XDR) tuberculosis, Thoracic Surgery, and Pulmonology; 15 days to 1 month.

name: PGIMER Chandigarh - Clinical Electives & Observership
organizer: Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education and Research, Chandigarh
eligibility: Medical undergraduates (final year MBBS), Interns, and MD/MS residents
prize_or_certificate: PGIMER Academic Certificate of Elective Training
notes: Benchmark postgraduate institute; departments include Hepatology, Advanced Eye Centre, Pulmonary Critical Care, and Pediatric Hematology-Oncology; 1 to 3 months.

name: Kidwai Memorial Institute of Oncology (KMIO) - Surgical Oncology Observership
organizer: Kidwai Memorial Institute of Oncology, Bengaluru (Autonomous Govt. of Karnataka Institute)
eligibility: General Surgery and OBGYN postgraduates (MS/DNB) and post-internship doctors
prize_or_certificate: KMIO Karnataka State Government Certificate
notes: Largest government comprehensive cancer centre in Karnataka; high exposure to surgical oncology, gynecological oncology, and palliative care; 2 to 4 weeks.

name: CMC Ludhiana - Rural and Community Health Elective
organizer: Christian Medical College, Ludhiana
eligibility: MBBS students (3rd/4th year) and interns
prize_or_certificate: CMC Ludhiana Rural Health Training Certificate
notes: Hands-on grassroots rural health management, primary healthcare epidemiology, and community nutrition exposure across outreach primary health centres.
